_nodes.description: Contains statistics about the number of nodes selected by the request’s node filters.

rest_actions.description:
The total number of times each REST endpoint has been called on this node since the last restart.
 Note that the REST endpoint names are not considered stable.

since.description: The timestamp for when the collection of these statistics started.

timestamp.description: The timestamp for when these statistics were collected.

aggregations.description: The total number of times search aggregations have been called on this node since the last restart.
